conditions: Explicit, standalone `::` paragraph form in Docutils 0.22.3 bundled reStructuredText specification r10253.
limitations: Inline, minimized forms and the detailed indentation and quoting rules have their own conditions.

triggers: Publisher correction, specification status change, edition remapping, preserved-byte mismatch or contrary publisher evidence.

statement: In the reStructuredText specification bundled with Docutils 0.22.3, a paragraph containing only two colons marks following text as a literal block when indented or quoted. The marker paragraph disappears from output and content inside the literal block is left without markup processing.
